mutations.name: a freeze stays in force after its date
kills: dispatch eligible a freeze in force refuses its tagged task, while a freeze whose end task is done or whose date passed does not

mutations.name: a freeze stays in force after its end task is done
kills: dispatch eligible a freeze in force refuses its tagged task, while a freeze whose end task is done or whose date passed does not

mutations.name: an unreadable task is dropped instead of refused
kills: dispatch eligible prints eligible tasks in bet order and refused tasks with their codes, calling only read commands

mutations.name: the tag filter is not passed to task.list
kills: dispatch eligible --tag narrows the candidates to one lane
